Inno Setup 6.7.4, license text stored as NOTICE.txt, copied unmodified from LICENSES/LicenseRef-Inno-Setup.txt (the version is pinned in packaging/win/innosetup.sha256).
Project: https://jrsoftware.org/isinfo.php
License: the Inno Setup License.
Used for: building the Windows installer. The installer program contains Inno Setup's runtime, so the license text must travel with it.
Inno Setup itself is not part of the plug-in, the zips or the macOS package. This notice folder is still copied into every package,
because the packaging script copies the notice files of every folder under third_party/; only LICENSES/LicenseRef-Inno-Setup.txt is
kept out of the zips and the macOS package.
